plugins.readme_text:
# @shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail · Ponytail for DeepSeek Harness

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[Ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)（懒人资深开发模式：最小改动解决问题，回复一段话就能看懂）
的 DeepSeek Harness 插件版。一次安装，6 个技能进入 `/` 菜单与模型的 skill 目录，
并且每个会话自动开启 ponytail 模式。

## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/shixingxingai/dsh-skill-ponytail.git
```

用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 指向本目录的绝对路径。
安装影响该 profile 的所有会话，重启后依然有效；卸载在 设置 → Plugins 里删除。

`install_bundle` 记下的是 `link:` 指向，profile 直接用这个克隆目录，不复制文件。所以：

- **不要移动或删除克隆目录**：下次启动解析不到插件，技能会消失。
- 更新用 `git pull`，然后重启 DeepSeek Harness（`entry.js` 是插件代码，要重启才加载新模块）。
- 每个 profile 各装一次；只装在 `desktop` 的插件，在 `web` profile 里不会出现。

包本身是 `private`，不发布到 npm；安装只走上面的本地目录方式。

## 使用

在输入框敲 `/` 从菜单选，或直接敲技能名（如 `/ponytail-review`）；
名字后面带词会一并送出（如 `/ponytail ultra`）。模型也可以通过 `skill` 工具按名加载。

| 技能 | 触发 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `ponytail` | `/ponytail` | 懒人资深模式本体：最小改动、一行回复说清跳过了什么、有什么风险。`/ponytail lite\|full\|ultra` 切换档位。 |
| `ponytail-review` | `/ponytail-review` | 审一次改动：bug、安全、负载、缺测试、慢、能删的代码。 |
| `ponytail-audit` | `/ponytail-audit` | 同样的质量审查，作用于整个仓库，按重要性排序。 |
| `ponytail-debt` | `/ponytail-debt` | 收集 `shortcut:` 注释，输出欠账清单。 |
| `ponytail-gain` | `/ponytail-gain` | 展示基准测试测得的收益。 |
| `ponytail-help` | `/ponytail-help` | 速查卡。 |

## 自动启用

插件开启时，每个会话自动进入 ponytail 模式（档位 **full**）：
`ponytail` 技能正文作为系统提示词段注入，从第一步起生效，子代理同样生效。
注入段只对**编码与仓库类任务**生效（写代码、修 bug、重构、评审、选依赖）；
做调研、写信、答问不套用这些规则。

- 换档：`/ponytail-mode lite\|full\|ultra`（推荐，直接改状态）；`/ponytail lite` 也仍可用
- 本会话退出：`/ponytail-mode off`，或说 "stop ponytail" / "normal mode"
- 所有会话不再自动启用：设置 → Plugins 里停用本插件

`/ponytail-mode` 走 Harness 的命令面（不生成模型消息、不消耗 token），handler 直接改插件状态：
注入段在下一步就按新档位重渲染，**关掉时整段从系统提示词移除**。因此它不依赖模型记住指令，
上下文压缩或多轮之后也不会"复活"。状态按会话保存在内存里，子代理继承父会话的档位，
重启应用后回到 **full**。不传参数（`/ponytail-mode`）会显示当前档位。

## 与上游的差异

- 6 个技能正文取自上游 `skills/` 目录，方法论未改；frontmatter 的 `description` 改为单行——**本插件只解析单行标量**，
  遇到上游那种 `description: >` 折叠写法会直接报错并跳过该技能（Harness 自身能正常解析多行，
  限制来自这里的手写解析器）；上游的 `argument-hint`、`license` 两个字段不再保留
  （技能调用与许可分别由 Harness 与 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 负责）。
- `ponytail-review` / `ponytail-audit` 的输出语言改为**跟随用户语言**（上游写死 “Very simple English”），
  报告的四段式结构与示例未变。
- `ponytail` 正文里「换档/退出」那一行按 Harness 的表述重写。
- 新增 `/ponytail-mode lite\|full\|ultra\|off` 命令：换档与退出不再只靠提示词自律，
  而是直接改插件状态，注入段随之下一步重渲染（off 时整段移除）；上游没有对应机制。
- 注入段增加的 scope 限定：只对编码与仓库类任务生效，非编码任务不套用。
- `ponytail-help` 的调用与更新说明改写为 Harness 的 `/` 菜单与 设置 → Plugins，
  并订正更新生效条件（正文下次加载生效，description 与 `entry.js` 需重启）。
- `ponytail-gain` 的条形图说明改为方块字符（示例本就用 `█`/`·`，原说明误写为 ASCII）。
- 新增 skill provider 注册与系统提示词自动注入：上游靠各宿主自行加载、只在被调用时生效。

## 结构

```
package.json            bundle 清单，dsh.bundle.patch 指向补丁
cordis.patch.yml        插入一行 ponytail
entry.js                Host 插件：注册 skill provider + 每会话注入 ponytail 系统提示词段
assets/<name>/SKILL.md  六个技能正文（name/description 在 YAML frontmatter）
locale/                 插件页显示的标题与描述
icon.svg                插件页图标
test/                   冒烟测试（node --test，GitHub Actions 自动跑）
```

技能正文以 `SKILL.md` 为准，`description` 从 frontmatter 单行读出。
改 `SKILL.md` 的**正文**，对 `/ponytail-*` 的调用立即生效（技能加载时才读盘）；但插件开启时注入的
ponytail 规则是**加载时的快照**，改完 `ponytail/SKILL.md` 正文后，那段系统提示词要重启
DeepSeek Harness 才更新（重启前技能正文与注入段会不一致）。**`description` 同样在插件加载时
读出并缓存，改后需重启**。改 `entry.js` 属于替换已安装包的代码，也需要重启才会加载新一代模块。

## 声明 / Attribution

本项目的技能正文（`assets/*/SKILL.md`）改写自
[DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
的 `skills/` 目录，原项目以 **MIT 许可**发布，版权归 DietrichGebert 所有。
原项目的版权与许可声明完整保留在本仓库 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 中（MIT 要求随副本保留）。

本仓库仅做 DeepSeek Harness 适配（skill provider 注册、系统提示词注入、locale），
未改动其方法论内容；Ponytail 名称与原项目成果归原作者所有。
本项目为独立的第三方移植，与原作者无隶属、背书或合作关系。

plugins.description: 把 DSH Web 界面换成自家品牌（Logo / 名称 / 中央标题 / favicon），并给页面与项目文件夹打上「为什么加 · 在干什么」水印。Rebrand your DSH web UI and stamp "why added / what job" watermarks on pages and project folders.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-brand-text

**English** | [中文](./README.zh.md)

Branding for the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Web** client, in **two layers**:

1. **Basics** — sidebar logo, sidebar name, the hero title in the middle of an empty conversation, browser tab title, favicon and PWA manifest.
2. **Watermark** — a translucent, opacity-tunable overlay on the page, **plus** a stamping ledger that writes *“why this was added”* and *“what job was running”* into the project files and folders DSH works on.

Both layers are edited from one settings panel (`/brand-studio/`) or by double-clicking in place, and both live in the same `brand.json`.

> ⚠ Not the same as the community plugin [`dsh-custom-brand`](https://github.com/baisama-cloud/dsh-custom-brand).
> Both occupy the sidebar brand slots, so **do not enable them together** — they fight over the same DOM.

## ① Basics — what you can change

| Item | Where it shows | Data key |
|---|---|---|
| Sidebar name | Top-left of the sidebar; also the browser tab title and PWA name | `productName` |
| Hero title | The line in the middle of an empty new conversation | `heroText` (empty = official default "Into the Unknown" / 「探索未至之境」) |
| Sidebar logo | Sidebar brand slot / favicon / PWA icon | `logoPath` |

Changes take effect on a **page refresh (F5)** — no DSH restart required.

This plugin also covers everything the community plugin `dsh-client-ui-brand` did (title / brand slots / favicon / manifest),
so you do **not** need to install that one.

## ② Watermark — why bother doing it inside DSH

The obvious use is stamping photos. The less obvious one is the reason this lives in DSH:

> You add a pile of project files/folders while working on something. Two weeks later you open them again and
> have no idea **why they were added** or **what job you were in the middle of**.

So the watermark stores two sentences — *why this was added* and *what is being worked on* — and shows them in two places:

| Form | Where you see it | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **A. Page overlay** | A translucent diagonal text layer over DSH | opacity / angle / size / tiled-or-single are all tunable; `pointer-events: none`, so it never blocks clicks |
| **B. File / folder stamp** | Inside the project directory — a `_DSH水印说明.md` note, an Explorer hover tip (InfoTip), and folder icon swapped to the brand mark | Written to the folder itself, so it survives outside DSH |

Stamps are tracked in a **ledger** (`watermark.targets`) with an *apply* / *undo* button per path. Undo removes the note,
restores the previous `desktop.ini`, and clears the folder attribute.

> Windows only for form B (it relies on `desktop.ini` + `attrib`). Form A works on any browser.
> Applying a stamp sets the **system** attribute on the target folder — that is how Explorer is told to read `desktop.ini`.
> Explorer may need F5 to pick it up.

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. install into a profile — npm first (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-brand-text

# 2. restart that DSH instance

# 3. open the settings panel
#    http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-port>/brand-studio/
```

If the GitHub route fails (network, pnpm build blocked, version gate), fall back to a local copy —
see [Install C](#c-from-a-local-folder-offline--fallback).

## Two ways to edit (same data, same API)

| Way | How | Good for |
|---|---|---|
| **Settings panel** | `http://127.0.0.1:<dsh-port>/brand-studio/` | Everything: basics, watermark tuning with a live preview, and the file/folder ledger |
| **Double-click in place** | Double-click the **top-left brand area** (logo or text) for a quick dialog; double-click the **hero line** to edit that copy | Quick tweaks — the page reloads after saving |

The dialog keeps the same order as the panel: **① basics first** (name, hero title, logo), **② watermark after it**
(enable switch, watermark text, *what job is running*, opacity slider).

> Trade-off: the sidebar brand area is normally a "new conversation" button, and a double-click would fire two clicks.
> To make double-click usable, the plugin swallows `click` / `pointerdown` on the brand slots —
> **a single click no longer starts a new conversation**; double-click edits, right-click opens the full panel.

## Install

**Recommended order: npm first (prebuilt, no pnpm build) → GitHub → local copy as the fallback.**

### A. From npm (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-brand-text
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Updates are just `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-brand-text`
(or remove + add again).

### B. Straight from GitHub

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Shushushu-whn/dsh-brand-text
```

### C. From a local folder (offline / fallback)

Use this when the GitHub route fails — no network, pnpm blocked from building a git dependency,
or a version gate stops the install.

```bash
# download or clone the repo, then:
cd /path/to/dsh-brand-text
node install.mjs --profile "<path-to-profile>"
```

`install.mjs` is idempotent: it writes a `link:` dependency, adds the plugin to `bundles`,
then runs `pnpm install`. Run it as often as you like.
Local installs pick up your edits immediately (no reinstall needed after changing `lib/`).

Manual equivalent, inside the target profile:

1. add `"dsh-brand-text": "link:<absolute path to this plugin>"` to `dependencies`
2. add `"dsh-brand-text"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` in the profile directory

## Uninstall

Remove `dsh-brand-text` from `dsh.profile.bundles` and `dependencies`, then run `pnpm install` again.
Undoing folder stamps first is a good idea (the ledger lives in `brand.json`, which you keep).
The `- id: dsh-brand-text` block in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` can stay (harmless) or be deleted.

## Configuration

The plugin takes a single option:

```yaml
- id: dsh-brand-text
  config:
    configPath: ''      # empty = brand.json next to the plugin
```

Each profile can override it, so one plugin can serve several brands:

```yaml
- id: dsh-brand-text
  config:
    configPath: 'D:\brands\team-a.json'
```

`brand.json` shape — see [brand.example.json](./brand.example.json):

```json
{
  "productName": "Acme Corp",
  "heroText": "Ask the drawings. Find the sheet. Check the spec.",
  "logoPath": "D:\\brands\\logo-mark.png",
  "watermark": {
    "enabled": true,
    "text": "Acme Corp — Site B",
    "task": "October payment-measurement paperwork",
    "note": "Client internal audit in early November, collecting raw records first",
    "opacity": 0.18,
    "angle": -20,
    "scale": 1,
    "repeat": true,
    "color": "#ffffff",
    "onPage": true,
    "targets": [
      { "path": "D:\\projects\\site-b", "purpose": "audit evidence", "task": "paperwork", "at": "2026-10-17 21:33" }
    ]
  }
}
```

Old files without a `watermark` key keep working — it defaults to disabled.

## HTTP routes

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /brand-studio/` | Settings panel (① basics, ② watermark) |
| `GET /brand-studio/api/config` | Current brand + watermark data |
| `POST /brand-studio/api/save` | Save ① (`{productName, heroText, logoDataUrl}`) |
| `POST /brand-studio/api/watermark` | Save ② overlay settings |
| `POST /brand-studio/api/watermark/target` | Apply / undo a folder stamp (`{path, purpose, task}` or `{remove:true, path}`) |
| `POST /brand-studio/api/open` | Open a ledger path in the file manager (ledger paths only) |
| `GET /brand-studio/watermark.svg` | Watermark tile — no params = current config, with params = live preview |
| `GET /brand-studio/watermark-card.svg` | A printable/savable summary card |
| `GET /brand-studio/logo` | Current logo, original bytes |
| `GET /brand-studio/mark.svg` | Square icon used for favicon / PWA |
| `GET /brand-studio/manifest.webmanifest` | PWA manifest |

> These routes skip the DSH token check (same as the official plugin routes) and listen on loopback only.
> If you expose DSH to a LAN, add your own access control.

## Compatibility

- Host: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.2.x (developed and verified on `0.2.1-alpha.4`).
- Uses three slots: `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`, `conversation.hero.brand.mark`,
  plus `webserver/index-inject` and the `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle

plugins.description: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset's pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 bash while keeping the official terminal contract (cwd, background jobs, timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gitbash

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

A Windows terminal bridge for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It replaces the
model-facing `pwsh` tool with a real `bash` tool, with selectable **Git for
Windows** and **MSYS2** profiles, while keeping the official terminal-tool
behaviour: working directory, background jobs, timeout promotion, permission
escalation, terminal cards, PTC and `meta.cwd`.

This is the complete user manual and reference. It covers installation, daily
usage, the security model, settings, troubleshooting and development.

> **Minimum DSH: 0.2.1.** Windows 10/11 only. The replacement applies to **new
> sessions**; existing sessions keep the tools they were created with.

---

## Contents

- [What you get](#what-you-get)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Security model (read this first)](#security-model-read-this-first)
- [Using the bash tool](#using-the-bash-tool)
- [Shell profiles](#shell-profiles)
- [Settings](#settings)
- [Cookbook](#cookbook)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Diagnostics](#diagnostics)
- [Compatibility and upgrades](#compatibility-and-upgrades)
- [Development](#development)
- [Limitations and non-goals](#limitations-and-non-goals)
- [License](#license)

---

## What you get

- **One `bash`, no `pwsh`** in the model tool catalogue: `tools.restrict` hides
  `pwsh`, the `tool:pwsh` prompt section is shadowed, and `tool:bash` is added.
  The replacement applies to new sessions; existing ones are not retrofitted.
- **Two shell families, one selector**: Git for Windows (default priority) or
  MSYS2 (`UCRT64`, `MINGW64`, `CLANG64`, `CLANGARM64`, `MINGW32`, `MSYS`).
  Discovery reads the registry, `where.exe`, PATH and the usual install roots,
  validates the candidate with `bash --version`, and never proposes WSL's
  `bash.exe`.
- **Official tool contract**: `description`, `command`, `timeoutMs`, `workdir`,
  `run_in_background`, `sandbox_permissions` / `justification`, POSIX and
  Windows-form workdirs, the same `[exit code: N]`, `[stderr]` and truncation
  spill markers, and `meta.cwd` for the terminal card.
- **Background work**: `run_in_background` returns a job id; collect with
  `job_output`, stop with `job_kill`, and a foreground call past its deadline is
  promoted to a job instead of being killed.
- **Isolation instead of improvisation**: PATH entries from the other bash
  family are filtered out, `MSYSTEM` matches the selected profile, and Git's
  `bin\bash.exe` launcher is canonicalized to `usr\bin\bash.exe`, so the
  environment the plugin composes is the one that actually runs.
- **Windows-specific correctness**: the `signalNumber << 8` exit encoding
  becomes `[killed by signal: SIGTERM]`, and inherited Windows `PWD` /
  `OLDPWD` are tombstoned so `pwd` stays POSIX.
- **Native DSH display**: terminal cards, the `1 background task` /
  `1 subagent` header badges, job cards and subagent cards are rendered by DSH
  itself — the plugin registers a `bash` tool with `meta.cwd`, it does not draw
  its own chat UI.
- **A compact settings row** with automatic discovery, an instant profile
  selector, compatibility mode, one-line warning and folded diagnostics.
- **Explicit security**: never silently widens permissions. `workspace-write`
  runs bash unconfined and labels the result with `[compat: ...]`, `read-only`
  refuses, and `strict` allows only `danger-full-access`. See
  [Security model](#security-model-read-this-first).
- **Verified**: 75 unit and integration tests, plus real-machine smoke on Git
  and MSYS2 (direct, background and subagent calls; light and dark settings UI).

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>= 0.2.1` (tested on desktop runtime `0.2.1-rc.2`) |
| Windows | Windows 10/11, x64; MSYS2 arm64 environments are also supported |
| bash provider | Git for Windows and/or MSYS2 |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24`, development/build only |
| Optional | Cygwin, best-effort and not recommended |

- Git Bash and MSYS2 both use the MSYS2 runtime. That runtime cannot start
  inside DSH's Windows ACL sandbox; this is an OS constraint, not a plugin bug
  (evidence in [docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)).
- WSL's `bash.exe` is intentionally excluded. WSL is not Git Bash and does not
  fit this profile/environment model.

---

## Install

### Use the CLI that ships with DSH Desktop

Do **not** use an old global npm `dsh` (for example `0.1.7`); it does not know
the 0.2.1 plugin/profile contract. Use the CLI under the desktop install:

```bat
set "DSH_CLI=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
%DSH_CLI% --version
:: expect 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer
```

Fully quit DSH Desktop before changing a profile.

### From a local checkout (development)

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/GitHub/dsh-gitbash-new
```

Reopen DSH, then hard-refresh the Web UI (`Ctrl+Shift+R`).

### From GitHub (after publishing)

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add github:riverzhou/dsh-gitbash-new
```

### From npm (published)

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add @riverzh/dsh-gitbash@0.2.2
```

Use `@riverzh/dsh-gitbash@latest` for the newest release.

### Upgrade

Use the same CLI, restart DSH, hard-refresh:

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop remove @riverzh/dsh-gitbash
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop add link:D:/GitHub/dsh-gitbash-new
```

For a released version, replace `link:...` with `@riverzh/dsh-gitbash@<version>`.

### Uninstall

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop remove @riverzh/dsh-gitbash
```

Restart DSH. The settings row disappears with the plugin. A `dsh-gitbash`
entry left in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` is inert and can be deleted
manually.

### Do not run two “bash instead of pwsh” plugins

`dsh-tweaks`' `git-bash-terminal-tool` also hides `pwsh` and registers `bash`.
If it is already installed, remove or disable it first:

```bat
%DSH_CLI% plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-tweaks-git-bash-terminal-tool
```

When both are present, the first one to replace wins; the later one usually
skips because `pwsh` is no longer restrictable. The log contains
`skipped ... pwsh is not restrictable`.

---

## Quick start

1. Install and restart DSH.
2. Open **Settings → General → Terminal tool (Git Bash / MSYS2)**.
3. Leave **Shell** at **Auto (recommended)**, or pick a specific Git/MSYS2
   profile.
4. Keep **Compatibility** at **Compatibility mode (recommended)** unless you
   want strict mode.
5. Start a **new** session and ask the model to run something:
   *“Use bash to print the shell, cwd and Git status.”*
6. Confirm the model calls `bash` (not `pwsh`) and the result carries the
   expected cwd.

The settings row looks like this:

![Settings row: terminal tool](docs/images/settings-row.png)

The Shell, Compatibility and MSYS2-environment dropdowns use the DSH light/dark
surface tokens, so both the closed control and the open list stay readable:

![Shell dropdown in dark theme](docs/images/settings-dropdown-dark.png)
![Shell dropdown in light theme](docs/images/settings-dropdown-light.png)

---

## Security model (read this first)

The MSYS2 runtime cannot start under DSH's Windows ACL sandbox: restricted
tokens break its named shared memory, signal pipe and `BaseNamedObjects`. Adding
the user SID defeats write confinement; lowering to Low integrity breaks
`BaseNamedObjects` again. There is no configuration in which Git Bash both runs
and stays inside that sandbox.

The plugin therefore makes the trade-off **explicit**:

| Session permission | `compat: auto` (default) | `compat: strict` |
|---|---|---|
| `danger-full-access` | bash runs normally | bash runs normally |
| `workspace-write` | bash runs **outside the file sandbox**, result carries `[compat: ...]` | **refused** |
| `read-only` | **refused** | **refused** |

- **File tools remain sandboxed** by DSH. Only the bash process is unconfined.
- Under `workspace-write` + `auto`, bash can write outside the workspace. Treat
  paths outside the workspace as read-only unless the user explicitly asks
  otherwise.
- The plugin never silently widens permissions. The warning is always in the
  s

plugins.description: Bulk RNA-seq and single-cell pseudo-bulk concordance, with DSH and MCP integrations for ChatGPT and Claude.
plugins.readme_text:
# Bulk–scRNA Concordance

Compare bulk RNA-seq expression with group-level pseudo-bulk profiles from
single-cell RNA-seq. Available as a DSH Host plugin, Python CLI and MCP server
for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

The tool reports Pearson and Spearman correlations, a linear regression,
optional group-matching diagnostics, and figures. Each run records parameters,
input/output hashes and package versions.

## Inputs and analysis

- Single-cell raw counts: `.h5ad`, or a genes × cells CSV with cell metadata.
- Bulk expression: a genes × samples CSV/TSV.
- A group label for each cell; bulk sample names must contain the matching
  group as an exact delimited token.

Cells are summed by group, and bulk samples are averaged within each group.
The default normalization is CPM followed by `log2(x+1)`. The regression and
figure use bulk as x and pseudo-bulk as y, with the same genes and transformations.

For `.h5ad`, the default count source is `layers['counts']` when available,
otherwise `X`. Select a layer with `--sc-layer <name>` or explicitly select
`raw.X` with `--sc-use-raw`. Gene metadata follows the selected matrix.
All single-cell inputs must contain raw counts: nonfinite, negative and
non-integer values are rejected. These checks cannot prove that integer-valued
data are untransformed; confirm the source before running.

This is a descriptive comparison. Pooling by group does not estimate biological
replicate variation. The optional matched–mismatched correlation gap can flag
unexpected matches, but does not prove biological agreement.

See [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md) for parameters, normalization and limitations.

## Requirements

Python with `numpy`, `pandas`, `scipy` and `matplotlib`; `.h5ad` input also
requires `anndata` and `h5py`.

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
```

## Real-data example: human iPSC (GSE77288)

This example compares independently measured bulk and single-cell read counts
from three donors in [Tung et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1038/srep39921),
available as [GSE77288](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE77288).
It uses the authors' 564 QC-passing cells and eight matching bulk libraries.
The QC list excludes all NA19098.r2 cells, so that batch's bulk library is also
excluded. Both inputs use untransformed read counts; the 92 ERCC spike-in
columns are removed.

![Bulk and single-cell expression concordance in three real iPSC donors](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation.png)

| Donor | Cells | Bulk libraries | Genes used | Pearson r | Spearman ρ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| NA19098 | 142 | 2 | 15,844 | 0.966628 | 0.963411 |
| NA19101 | 201 | 3 | 16,440 | 0.968652 | 0.967269 |
| NA19239 | 221 | 3 | 16,247 | 0.972792 | 0.970065 |

The figure uses default shared axes, hexagonal gene-density bins, a logarithmic
gene-count colorbar, grid lines, regression lines and per-panel statistics.
The reference run used analysis commit
[`7478bde`](https://github.com/Wanner122333/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance/commit/7478bdef898cdca66ba05b101f6a5cbfe239035e).
Raw counts and the correlations/regressions were checked independently.

[PDF](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation.pdf) ·
[SVG](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation.svg) ·
[Statistics CSV](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_bulk_scrna_correlation_stats.csv) ·
[Cross-donor correlations](examples/gse77288/results/GSE77288_real_discriminability.csv) ·
[Results, parameters and source hashes](examples/gse77288/reference_run.json)

From the repository root, prepare the public inputs and run the same analysis:

```bash
python examples/gse77288/prepare.py --out-dir results/gse77288/input-data
python python/bulk_scrna_concordance.py \
  --sc-h5ad results/gse77288/input-data/sc_read_counts.h5ad \
  --bulk-csv results/gse77288/input-data/bulk_read_counts.csv \
  --group-col individual --gene-id-key var_names --discriminability \
  --out-dir results/gse77288 --out-prefix GSE77288_real \
  --results-json results/gse77288/GSE77288_real_results.json
```

The preparation script downloads about 13 MB of compressed counts plus sample
annotations, verifies fixed SHA-256 hashes, and writes raw-count inputs and
provenance. It reuses verified cached downloads on later runs. The underlying
counts are downloaded from their public sources rather than bundled here.
See the [example notes](examples/gse77288/README.md) for filtering, caching and
the reference environment. All three donors are iPSCs: these gene-wise
correlations describe expression agreement, not biological replicate inference
or general classification accuracy. Pearson p-values underflow to zero in the
statistics CSV and display as `p < 1e-300` in the figure.

## Command line

Run the included synthetic fixture:

```bash
python python/bulk_scrna_concordance.py \
  --sc-matrix-csv examples/synthetic/sc_expr.csv \
  --sc-meta-csv examples/synthetic/sc_meta.csv \
  --bulk-csv examples/synthetic/bulk.csv \
  --group-col Group --discriminability \
  --out-dir results --out-prefix example \
  --results-json results/example_results.json
```

For real `.h5ad` data:

```bash
python python/bulk_scrna_concordance.py \
  --sc-h5ad /path/to/counts.h5ad --sc-layer counts \
  --bulk-csv /path/to/bulk.csv --group-col Group \
  --out-dir results --out-prefix my_run \
  --results-json results/my_run_results.json
```

## DSH plugin

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Wanner122333/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance.git
```

In DSH, open **Settings → Plugins** and install the bundle using the absolute
path to the checkout containing `package.json`. The registered tool is
`bulk_scrna_concordance`. Check the installation result and restart DSH if it
reports `restart-required`.

For profiles managed through the CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance
```

Set `pythonPath` in the profile's plugin configuration if the required Python
interpreter is not on its `PATH`:

```yaml
- id: bulk-scrna-concordance
  name: "@local/dsh-bulk-scrna-concordance"
  config:
    pythonPath: /absolute/path/to/python
    defaultTimeoutMs: 1800000
    maxLogLines: 40
```

Use the in-app installer for the Desktop-owned profile.

## ChatGPT and Claude through MCP

Install the optional MCP dependencies:

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements-mcp.txt
python python/mcp_server.py --transport stdio --workspace /path/to/data
```

The server exposes `bulk_scrna_concordance` through stdio for local clients
such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code. Streamable HTTP is also supported.
ChatGPT can connect through Secure MCP Tunnel or an operator-deployed HTTPS
endpoint; account and workspace policies apply. See [MCP setup](docs/mcp.md)
for client configuration and deployment requirements.

Inputs must exist on the server machine. The server returns statistics and
artifact paths; it does not upload chat attachments or serve file downloads.
The HTTP server has no built-in authentication and binds to loopback by
default. Keep it private, or place it behind an authenticated HTTPS proxy.

## Outputs

Files are written under `--out-dir`:

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `<prefix>_results.json` | Parameters, per-group statistics, diagnostics and warnings; CLI requires `--results-json` |
| `<prefix>_bulk_scrna_correlation_stats.csv` | Per-group statistics |
| `<prefix>_discriminability.csv` | Pseudo-bulk × bulk correlation matrix, when requested |
| `<prefix>_bulk_scrna_correlation.{png,pdf,svg}` | Scatter plots with regression and y=x lines |
| `<prefix>_manifest.json` | Code/input/output hashes and recorded environment versions |
| `<prefix>_run.log` | Analysis log when called through DSH or MCP |

The manifest's `environment_lock` field records installed versions; it is not
an installable dependency lockfile.

## Checks

```bash
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
node --check index.js
```

These synthetic regression checks cover input handling and numerical behavior.
They do not establish biological validity or confirm an installed host's setup.

plugins.description: Delete DSH sessions from the sidebar — restorable trash can or permanent purge.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-delete

在 DSH 侧边栏删除会话 —— 先移入可恢复的回收站，或彻底清除。

> Delete DSH sessions from the Session row's "…" menu: move to a restorable
> trash can, or purge. DSH itself ships no delete action, and its session
> storage seam has no delete API by design, so this plugin moves the session
> directory out of `$DSH_HOME/sessions` and keeps a `meta.json` so it can be
> put back.

## 为什么需要它

DSH 的会话行菜单里有 **置顶、重命名、分叉、归档**，没有删除；会话日志在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 下一直累积，只能手工清。协议里虽然有 `session/delete`，但它只对外部 ACP agent 生效，宿主自己的存储层明确写着「不删除会话文件 —— 直到外部移除」。

所以删除只能落在文件系统上。本插件只做这一件事，并且把它做成**可逆**的。

## 功能

| 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **删除会话** | 把 `sessions/<工作区>/session-<id>/` 整体移进 `$DSH_HOME/session-trash/<时间戳>/`，附 `meta.json` 记录原工作区与目录名 |
| **彻底删除会话** | 同上移入，然后立刻从回收站清除。红色危险样式，二次确认 |

- **正在使用的会话删不掉**：Windows 上目录里有被占用的日志文件时 `rename` 会失败，插件把它报成「该会话正在被使用，先切到别的会话再删除」——不会半删一半
- **删完自动刷新**页面，侧边栏不再显示该行
- 菜单项的字号、行高、内边距、悬停与危险色**对齐 DSH 自带的菜单单元格**（13px / 20px / 34px / 6px 8px）

## 安装

```sh
# 从 npm（发布后）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @jackal-alex/dsh-session-delete

# 从 GitHub（需要本机有 git）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:jackal-Alex/dsh-session-delete

# 本地开发（软链，改完硬刷新即可）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-session-delete
```

> ⚠️ **别装错**：npm 上另有一个第三方同名插件 `dsh-session-delete`（作者 vtxf，仓库 `vtxf/dsh-session-delete`），功能相近但**不是本项目**。本项目的 npm 包名带 scope，是 **`@jackal-alex/dsh-session-delete`**（GitHub 仓库是 `jackal-Alex/dsh-session-delete`），装的时候认准这两处作者名。

装完**重启 DSH**（bundle 层在启动时装配），再按 **Ctrl+Shift+R** 硬刷新页面加载客户端半边。

## 用法

1. 鼠标移到任意会话行，点右侧的「…」
2. 选 **删除会话**，确认
3. 会话从列表消失；文件在 `~/.dsh/session-trash/` 里

恢复（接口已就绪，暂无 UI）：

```sh
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/session-delete/restore \
  -H "content-type: application/json" -H "x-dsh-session-delete: 1" \
  -d '{"trashId":"<回收站目录名>"}'
```

## 宿主接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/session-delete/list` | 列出磁盘上的会话（工作区、id、大小、时间） |
| GET | `/api/session-delete/trash` | 列出回收站条目 |
| POST | `/api/session-delete/delete` | `{sessionId, mode?}` —— `mode: "purge"` 移入后立刻清除 |
| POST | `/api/session-delete/restore` | `{trashId}` —— 放回原位置 |
| POST | `/api/session-delete/purge` | `{trashId}` —— 彻底删除，不可恢复 |

所有请求（**包括 GET**）都必须带 `x-dsh-session-delete: 1`，并且只接受回环对端（`127.0.0.1` / `::1`）。
原因：DSH 把 `exact` 类型的路由注册在它自己的鉴权围栏之前，插件必须自己上闸 —— 自定义头会触发跨站预检（这些路由不发放 CORS），回环判断则拦住非本机来源。手工调用时记得带上：

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/session-delete/list -H "x-dsh-session-delete: 1"
```

## 兼容性

**不声明任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 `peerDependencies`。** DSH 0.2+ 的版本闸门会把 peer 对不上的插件**整包跳过**（现象是「装上了，重启后什么也没发生」，且不报错）；客户端半边只用 `ctx.slots`，宿主半边只用 `ctx.webServer`，都不静态依赖某个宿主包的具体版本。

在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**（Windows 桌面版）上实测可用。

## 测试

不需要构建、不需要 DSH 运行时，纯 Node 即可：

```sh
npm run check   # node --check 三个入口
npm test        # 三个测试文件
```

- `tests/host.test.mjs` —— 文件层：list → trash → restore → trash → purge，含路径穿越拒绝
- `tests/routes.test.mjs` —— 用假 cordis context 驱动五条路由，覆盖 405 / 403 / 404 / 400
- `tests/client.test.mjs` —— 替身 `__ModuleLoader__` + 假 `require` + 假 DOM，验证装配、两个菜单项的 order 与注入面、以及**菜单单元格的度量**（防字体回退）

## 已知限制

- 删除后靠 `location.reload()` 刷新列表
- 没有批量删除、没有回收站的 UI 列表（接口 `trash` / `restore` / `purge` 已就绪）
- 只处理 `sessions/<工作区>/session-<id>/` 这种目录布局；平铺或压缩的单文件布局不在本版范围
- 彻底删除不做 shred（不是安全擦除）

## 开发

插件是**手写、无构建**的：宿主半边是普通 ESM，客户端半边是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 的 self-contained bundle。改 `lib/*.js` 后重跑 `npm test`，硬刷新页面即可看到客户端改动。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: 桥接市场：给 DeepSeek Harness 的应用商店。49 个网站或 app 按卡片挑，点接入，agent 当场多出 mcp__<app>__* 工具；能一键接的一键接，接不上的给分步教程。
plugins.readme_text:
# 桥接市场 · dsh-bridge-market

**给 agent 用的应用商店。** 在列表里挑一个网站或 app，点「接入」，agent 当场就多出一批能调用它的工具——不用记 npm 包名，不用手写 YAML，不用懂 MCP 是什么。

![发现应用](docs/screenshots/discover.png)

---

## 它解决什么问题

| 没有它 | 有了它 |
| --- | --- |
| 想让 agent 查高德地图，得先去搜「高德 MCP 服务器」的包名、启动命令、参数格式、key 塞哪个环境变量 | 打开面板搜「高德」，点「接入」，把 key 填进那个输入框 |
| 手动改 `cordis.patch.yml`，缩进错一格整行不生效 | 关心里写什么，不关心 YAML |
| 装完不知道到底连上没连上 | 卡片右边直接显示「工具 N」，N 就是 agent 现在真能用的工具个数 |
| 想接十几个 app，配一次忘一次 | 全部在「已接入」页签里，随时停用、编辑、断开 |

一句话：**把「配一个 MCP 服务器」变成「装一个 app」。**

---

## 能干什么

1. **按应用挑，不按包名挑**——目录里的单位是「高德地图」「飞书」「GitHub」，不是 `@xxx/mcp-server-yyy`。
2. **点一下就接入**——写入配置、热加载、工具就位，不用重启 DSH。
3. **接入结果可验证**——每张卡显示「工具 N」，数的是 agent 工具表里真实出现的 `mcp__<应用>__*`，不是猜的。
4. **筛选和搜索**——按分类过滤，另有「免密钥」和「已接入」两个快捷筛选。
5. **四种条目说清楚**——标「免密钥」（直接能用）、「需 Key」（要申请）、「需教程」（官方只走 OAuth，点进去看分步接入）、「仅说明」（当前真接不上，不假装能用）。
6. **agent 自己也能装**——注册了 `bridge_market` 工具，一句「帮我接上高德，key 是 xxx」就能完成。

---

## 怎么用

**第 1 步：安装**

让 agent 装，或手动：

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <本目录的绝对路径>
```

装完**重启一次 DSH**——插件带的工具和面板要在启动时注册。

**第 2 步：打开面板**

左侧边栏点「桥接市场」。两个页签：

| 页签 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 发现应用 | 卡片墙 + 搜索框 + 分类筛选。点卡片或右下角「接入」进配置 |
| 已接入 | 已连上的应用，右键显示工具数，可停用 / 编辑 / 断开 |

右上角「手动配置」可以直接粘贴 Claude Code 的 `.mcp.json` 片段，一次接一批。

![免密钥筛选](docs/screenshots/free.png)

**第 3 步：接入并验收**

选应用 → 填 key（如果要）→ 保存 → 看「已接入」页签的**「工具 N」**：

- **N > 0**：真的连上了，agent 现在就能用（MCP 握手是异步的，可能要等 5–10 秒）
- **N = 0**：没连上。依次查 key 对不对、域名通不通、这个端点是不是其实要求 OAuth

![已接入](docs/screenshots/installed.png)

**接不上的那种，给教程**

官方只走 OAuth 的应用（Supabase、Linear、Vercel、Intercom）接不了静态 key，所以卡片上标「需教程」，点进去是照抄就能用的分步说明：

![教程页](docs/screenshots/guide.png)

---

## 先拿这 9 个练手（都不用申请 key）

| 应用 | 能干什么 |
| --- | --- |
| DeepWiki | 对任意 GitHub 仓库提问，读它的代码结构说明 |
| Context7 | 查某个库/框架的最新官方文档和用法 |
| Cloudflare 文档检索 | 查 Cloudflare 官方文档 |
| Hugging Face | 搜模型、数据集、论文 |
| Firecrawl | 抓网页、爬站，转成 markdown |
| Exa 搜索 | 语义搜索（不填 key 也能用，有速率限制） |
| Playwright | 让 agent 开浏览器、点页面、截图 |
| Chrome DevTools MCP | 连本机 Chrome，截图、读 console、看网络请求 |
| Pixo MCP（桌面端） | 连本机 Pixo 客户端 |

---

## 目录里有什么

**一键接入（点「接入」写配置，刷新就能调）**（`*` = 必填 key）：

| 分类 | 应用 | 需要的 key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 地图/出行 | 高德地图 | `key*` |
| 地图/出行 | 腾讯地图 | `key*` |
| 地图/出行 | 百度地图 | `BAIDU_MAP_API_KEY*` |
| 地图/出行 | Google Maps | `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY*` |
| 协作/IM | 飞书 / Lark | `appId*`、`appSecret*` |
| 协作/IM | 钉钉 | `DINGTALK_Client_ID*`、`DINGTALK_Client_Secret*` |
| 协作/IM | Slack | `SLACK_MCP_XOXP_TOKEN*` |
| 知识库/文档 | Notion | `token*`（Integration Token） |
| 代码托管 | GitHub | `token*` |
| API 工具 | Postman | `token*` |
| 云服务/后端 | Cloudflare | `token*` |
| 云服务/后端 | Neon Postgres | `apiKey*` |
| 云服务/后端 | Kubernetes | 读本机 kubeconfig，免填 |
| 支付/金融 | Stripe | `token*` |
| 支付/金融 | PayPal | `token*`（可留 `env`，默认沙箱） |
| 搜索/检索 | Exa 搜索 | 可不填 |
| 搜索/检索 | Brave 搜索 | `BRAVE_API_KEY*` |
| 搜索/检索 | DeepWiki | 不需要 |
| 搜索/检索 | Cloudflare 文档检索 | 不需要 |
| 搜索/检索 | Firecrawl | 不需要（不填 key 有额度限制） |
| 搜索/检索 | Tavily 搜索 | `key*` |
| AI 平台 | 魔搭 ModelScope | `MODELSCOPE_API_TOKEN*` |
| AI 平台 | Hugging Face | 不需要（登录后更全） |
| AI 平台 | Sequential Thinking | 不需要 |
| 数据库 | PostgreSQL | 连接串 `*` |
| 数据库 | MySQL / MariaDB | 主机、用户、密码 `*` |
| 数据库 | Elasticsearch | `ES_URL*`、`ES_API_KEY` |
| 本机能力 | 文件系统（限定目录） | 目录路径 `*` |
| 本机能力 | Docker 容器 | 不需要（Docker 要开着） |
| 本机能力 | Memory 知识图谱 | 可不填（本地 JSON） |
| 设计/图像 | ArtCraft · PhotoCraft | 填本机 `photocraft-cli.exe` 路径 |
| 浏览器自动化 | Playwright | 不需要 |
| 浏览器自动化 | Puppeteer | 不需要 |
| 浏览器自动化 | Browser MCP（操控你自己的浏览器） | 需要先装浏览器扩展 |
| 开发工具 | Sentry | `token*`（自建加 `--host`） |

**4 个教程条目**：Supabase、Linear、Vercel、Intercom。官方只给 OAuth 网页授权，本机连不上，所以不假装能一键接——点卡片进去是分步教程，照抄就能用；Supabase 那条还附了可直接粘进「手动配置」的 JSON。

**2 个说明卡**：Figma、蓝湖——只说明为什么接不上，不写假的接入按钮。

**11 条上游模板**：Apifox、Apipost、MasterGo、Pixso、Chrome DevTools、Context7 等，和上面的目录混在一起显示，界面共 50 条（15 条免密钥，点开即用）。

---

## 让 agent 自己接

插件注册了一个 `bridge_market` 工具：

| action | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `list` | 列目录，标「可接入 / 已接入 / 仅说明」，并说明还差哪几个必填键 |
| `attach` | 接入，例如 `{app: "app-amap", config: {key: "…"}}`；缺必填项会直接告诉你要补什么 |
| `detach` | 断开（只能移除本插件自己接的桥） |
| `status` | 列出所有桥和它们的工具数 |

所以你可以直接说：「帮我接上高德地图，key 是 xxx」，然后问「现在高德有哪些工具能用」。

---

## 常见问题

**接入后「工具 N」一直是 0？**
MCP 握手是异步的，等 5–10 秒。仍是 0 就查：key 是否正确、端点域名是否可达、是否要求 OAuth。

**Windows 上 stdio 应用为什么起不来？**
Windows 里 `npx`、`uvx` 这类命令只是 `.cmd` 包装，进程直接按名字启动会失败（实测 `spawnSync("npx")` 报 `ENOENT`）。本插件写配置时会自动改写成 `cmd /c npx ...`，所以面板里接入的都能跑；你自己手写配置或粘贴别人的 JSON 时，要自己补这层包装。

**显示已接入，但 agent 不会用？**
先确认「工具 N」> 0。装了新版本没重启 DSH 的话，面板和 `bridge_market` 工具都不会出现。

**会覆盖我手写的 MCP 配置吗？**
不会。只重写本插件自己两条 marker 之间的内容，文件其余部分逐字节保留；你自己写的行在列表里作为只读条目显示。

**key 存在哪？**
当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，明文——就是普通配置文件。列表接口返回的是掩码值，面板 HTTP 接口只接受本机（loopback）请求。

**有风险吗？**
有。接入第三方 MCP 等于让外部代码用你的身份跑。标注「社区 MCP」的（靠浏览器自动化或逆向接口的那种）还有账号风控风险。接入前先看条目里的说明和文档链接。

---

## 怎么实现的

每座桥 = 一个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 插件实例行，由本插件维护在当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 托管区域内：

```yaml
# >>> dsh-bridge-market managed region >>> （请通过「桥接市场」面板管理，勿手改）
- insert:
    - id: mcp-market-context7
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: context7
        transport: streamable-http
        url: https://mcp.context7.com/mcp
        headers: {}
# <<< dsh-bridge-market managed region <<<
```

三个要点：

1. **profile 自动解析**：上游写死 `profiles/web`，在 desktop / headless profile 下会写进 loader 不监视的文件——面板显示已接入，工具永远不出来。本插件按 `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` → `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>` → argv 里 `...\profiles\<name>` → cwd 依次解析。
2. **热加载 + 闭环验证**：写入后 loader 自动重载该行，不必重启；「工具 N」数的是 `tools.schemas()` 里真实出现的 `mcp__<name>__*`。
3. **托管区域**：只重写两条 marker 之间的内容，写入走临时文件 + rename，原子替换。

目录数据在 `src/catalog.js`（`APP_CATALOG`）和 `src/templates.js`（`TEMPLATES`）。**加一个应用 = 加一个对象**，不用改别的地方。

### 开发

```powershell
npm install --no-save esbuild        # build.mjs 用 esbuild 打包客户端
node build.mjs                       # 产出 dist/index.js（host）与 lib/client.js（client）
node --test tests/*.test.mjs         # 12 个用例：托管区读写、CRUD、粘贴解析、bridge_market 工具
```

测试用临时 `DSH_HOME` + `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` 隔离，不会碰真实配置。

---

## 归属

改造自 [Mrxieyong/dsh-mcp-market](https://github.com/Mrxieyong/dsh-mcp-market) v0.2.0（MIT），保留其 LICENSE，以及托管区写入、路由、粘贴解析等基础实现。在此之上新增：应用目录、profile 自动解析、工具数徽标、搜索与分类筛选、`bridge_market` 工具，以及「按应用接入」的产品定位与界面。

MIT License。

plugins.description: DSH plugin: host-wide MCP config scan + auto-import, plus a live MCP market (six catalogs, a local GitHub census, and install-command recovery)
plugins.readme_text:
dsh-overall-mcp

English | 中文

**A DeepSeek Harness plugin that scans every MCP configuration on the machine on first install and registers what it finds; aggregates six open MCP catalogs (5,364 deduplicated entries measured 2026-10) into one browsable, one-click-installable panel; and keeps a local census index of MCP repositories on GitHub (1,758 rows measured), recovering install commands from repository evidence and labelling each recovered command with where it came from.** `README.zh-CN.md` is the same document in Chinese. [docs/ENGINEERING.md](https://github.com/YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp/blob/main/docs/ENGINEERING.md) keeps the engineering record — the measurements, the alternatives that were rejected, and why each choice went the way it did. The README describes what the plugin does; that file describes how it got there. [docs/install-check.md](https://github.com/YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp/blob/main/docs/install-check.md) is narrower: one measured install from GitHub — the timings, what the lockfile pins, and why this plugin is not published to npm. ## What it looks like These are screenshots of the real panel: `tools/readme-shots.mjs` renders them from the **real client code** (the same `client/client.js`) over a fixed fixture, so the pictures cannot drift from what the code draws. `npm test` checks that every image referenced here exists. ### Registered: source groups, and the two walks on the GitHub card ![The Registered tab: servers grouped by where they came from, above a GitHub access card that names the census index, why the last walk stopped, and offers "继续恢复"](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp/main/docs/images/registered.png) ### Market: six catalogues behind one search box ![The MCP market tab: search, category and source filters, the per-source count line, and the card wall with stars, licence, tags and a media strip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp/main/docs/images/market.png) ### Detail: everything behind one card ![The detail panel: repository stats (stars, forks, licence, language, last push), source and author, and the command that will be run with its copy button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YunzhouLi-hub/dsh-overall-mcp/main/docs/images/detail.png) ## Features | | Capability | What it does | |---|---|---| | 🔍 | Scan on first install | Discovers and registers every MCP server configured in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code (Copilot), Windsurf, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI | | 🌐 | MCP market | Six sources aggregated in parallel — official Registry, Smithery, Docker MCP Catalog, GitHub MCP, Awesome remote, Awesome list — **5,364 entries measured**. Browse with no keyword, filter by source, search. (The GitHub source reads the local census index and makes **zero requests** when an index exists; rows without install data get a command recovered from repository evidence, with the source named.) | | ⚡ | One-click connect | npm package → `npx -y `, Python package → `uvx`, hosted endpoint → streamable-http, Docker image → `docker run -i --rm mcp/`; listing-only entries offer their repository link | | 🧩 | Settings before it can work | A server that installs can still be unusable — a missing API key makes every tool call answer `401`. The declaration is read from the official Registry (or from the entry's own launcher), stored with the row, and shown as a **待配置** badge plus a one-line page banner; **配置** opens a masked form, saving remounts only a row that was already enabled, and the install reply opens the form for what it just wrote (`GET /servers`, `POST /configure`, `overall_mcp_configure`, round 25) | | 🛠️ | Native tool bridge | Each enabled server is mounted as one `dsh-mcp-client` instance; its tools register as native DSH tools named `mcp____` | | 🖥️ | Sidebar panel | **Global MCP**, directly under *Plugins*: a **Registered** tab (grouped by source, collapsible, per-group switch, status filters) and an **MCP Market** tab | | 🎛️ | Per-group switches | One switch per source group enables/disables every server from that source (also available as `overall_mcp_set_source_enabled`) | | ⬆️ | Version check and update | Checks npm/PyPI for servers launched through `npx`/`uvx` (including Windows `cmd.exe /c` wrappers); a green `Update all (N)` runs them with per-row progress, and turns into `✓ done` when the queue has answered every row | | 🪪 | Identity line | The panel's second line says **which code this process is running**: plugin version, pid, uptime, readable data files, log lines. When the files on disk are newer than the process it adds `⚠ code updated, restart DSH` — "still broken" and "not loaded yet" stop being the same sentence (`GET /status`) | | 🧾 | Action log | The host writes its actions to `events.ndjson` (browse/per-source outcome/quota/scan/census/evidence/install/update/mount/registry repair), expandable from the header. Metadata only, never secrets, last 400 lines | | 🔑 | GitHub credentials and census resume | A token can be pasted in the panel (or taken from `gh auth token`); it takes effect only after validation and is sent only to GitHub hosts. **Anonymous still works** — the budget is just 60/h instead of 5,000/h. One network failure no longer ends a census (per-repository retry with backoff, stop after repeated rejections), and the next run resumes from where it stopped (`GET\|POST\|DELETE /auth`) | | ⏯️ | Start and stop the census yourself | The GitHub access card on the *Registered* tab states where the census stands (how many rows, when it last read, who stopped it) and offers the verb that matches: *start* (no waiting for the cache to expire) or *stop* with live progress. Stopping is safe — rows are written as they arrive, the next run resumes from the missing repositories, and a stopped run will not spend budget on install evidence afterwards (`GET\|POST /census`, round 22) | | 🔧 | Start and stop the recovery walk yourself | The same card carries a **second walk** (reading repository evidence to recover install commands) with its own state line and its own verb: `tried 78 / 2.1k repositories` while running, *resume recovery* when rows are left. It used to start by itself when the market opened and could only be ended by unloading the plugin — and a full pass is 150ms × more than two thousand repositories (`GET\|POST /install-evidence`, round 23) | | 🗂️ | Read the local census as a source | The source filter offers *local census (index)* right beside *GitHub*: same index on disk, but **not one request spent**, and an old index is not quietly re-walked. It is not a seventh source — counts still belong to GitHub (one upstream, one number) — it just makes "I am reading the list I already have" a choice you can make (`?source=census`, round 24) | | 🧮 | Every number and time states its meaning | Per-source counts use the same ruler as "N total" (deduplicated, with `deduped` shown separately); "listing read at" is local read time while "upstream updated" is the repository's last push; when sorting by usage, a card with no usage data says so instead of silently sorting by quality; inferred categories carry "(inferred)" on the card, in the detail panel and in the category dropdown | ## Quick start ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-overall-mcp ``` Restart the profile: the first load scans the host's MCP configs. The entry appears in the sidebar under **Plugins**. The page is a **global panel** in the sidebar (not a setting, not a plugin config area): the rail icon is registered in the `sidebar.panellist` slot (`order: 5`, between the official Plugins page at 0 and Tasks at 10) and the panel itself in the layout's keyed `main` slot — both under the same id

plugins.description: OpenAI-compatible local proxy exposing JoyCode (JD Cloud JoyCoder) credits, plus a DSH model-provider plugin
plugins.readme_text:
# joycode-proxy

> 📘 English documentation: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

把 **JoyCode（京东云 JoyCoder 积分）** 反代成一个 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务，再通过一个 DSH provider 插件把它的积分池接进 DSH，当作 agent 的模型后端。整体思路与 `qoder-proxy` / `dsh-llm-qoder` 完全一致，只是后端换成了 JoyCode 的「color gateway」协议。

## 架构

```
DSH agent
  └─ ctx.llm.registerAdapter(["joycode"], adapter)   ← dsh-llm-joycode 插件
       └─ PiAiAdapter → openAICompletionsApi(baseUrl=本地 shim)
            └─ POST http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/chat/completions
                 └─ joycode-proxy (server.mjs)
                      └─ POST https://api-ai.jd.com/api?appid=joycode_ide&functionId=chat_completions&t=...&sign=...
                           (HMAC-SHA256 签名 + ptKey 头)
                           └─ JoyCode 后端（同一账号的积分计费）
```

## 端点

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| GET  | `/v1/models` | 返回 JoyCode 后端模型列表 |
| POST | `/v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI 兼容，支持 `stream: true/false` |
| GET  | `/health` | 探活 + 配置自检 |

## 为什么用「color gateway」而不是逆向

JoyCode IDE 的请求签名与鉴权都在它自带的 `extension.js` 里明文实现，核心只有三样东西：

1. **网关地址**：`https://api-ai.jd.com/api`（登录态里的 `colorBaseUrl`）。
2. **鉴权头**：`ptKey`（登录态里的 `ptKey`，即京东云账号票据）+ 可选 `loginType`/`tenant`。
3. **签名**：对 `{appid, functionId, t}` 排序后取非空值 `&` 拼接，用 HMAC-SHA256 + IDE 内置签名密钥算 hex，作为 `sign` 查询参数。

因此不需要逆向任何加密/WASM，直接把这段签名逻辑复刻成 `server.mjs` 里的 `signQuery()` / `gatewayUrl()` 即可。

> **关于那个签名密钥**：它是 IDE 客户端内置的**公开协议常量**，随 IDE 分发给每个用户，不是账号凭据——单独拿到它无法发起任何有效请求。真正的凭据是 `ptKey`，**只从环境变量读、永不入库**。若上游轮换密钥，重新从 `extension.js` 提取，或用 `JOYCODE_SIGN_KEY` 覆盖。

## 配置（环境变量）

| 变量 | 必需 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| `JOYCODE_PT_KEY` | ✅ | 空 | 账号票据（登录态 `jdhLoginInfo.ptKey`） |
| `JOYCODE_TENANT` | ⭕ | 空 | 租户 ID（登录态 `tenant`） |
| `JOYCODE_COLOR_BASE_URL` | ⭕ | `https://api-ai.jd.com` | 网关 origin（登录态 `colorBaseUrl`） |
| `JOYCODE_MASTER_BASE_URL` | ⭕ | 空 | 直连 origin（登录态 `masterBaseUrl`），网关不可用时兜底 |
| `JOYCODE_LOGIN_TYPE` | ⭕ | `PIN_JD_CLOUD` | 登录类型 |
| `JOYCODE_SIGN_KEY` | ⭕ | 内置常量 | 覆盖签名密钥（上游轮换时用） |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_PORT` | ⭕ | `8318` | 本地监听端口 |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_HOST` | ⭕ | `127.0.0.1` | 监听地址 |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_MODEL` | ⭕ | `JoyAI-Code-1.6` | 缺省模型 |
| `JOYCODE_PROXY_API_KEY` | ⭕ | 空 | 设置后要求 `Authorization: Bearer <key>` |

> **怎么拿到自己的凭据**：JoyCode IDE 的登录态存在一个 SQLite 库里
> （Windows `%APPDATA%\JoyCode\User\globalStorage\state.vscdb`；
> macOS `~/Library/Application Support/JoyCode/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`；
> Linux `~/.config/JoyCode/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb`）。
> 读 `ItemTable` 表里 key 为 `JoyCoder.IDE` 的那一行，其 JSON 的
> `joyCoderUser` 里就有 `ptKey` / `colorBaseUrl` / `masterBaseUrl` / `tenant`。
> 把这些填进 `.env`（见 `.env.example`）。**`.env` 已在 `.gitignore` 里，绝不要提交。**
>
> 不想手动抠？跑 `npm run setup`，它会自动从本机 IDE 登录态读出凭据写进 `.env`。

## 模型列表（后端实时返回）

- `JoyAI-Code-1.6`
- `GLM-5.3-agent`（GLM-5.3）
- `Kimi-K2.6-agent`（Kimi-K2.6，多模态）
- `MiniMax-M3-agent`（MiniMax-M3，多模态）
- `Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro-agent`（Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro，多模态）

## 启动

```powershell
$env:JOYCODE_PT_KEY = "<ptKey>"
node server.mjs
```

验证：

```powershell
curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/models
curl.exe -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/chat/completions `
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
  -d '{\"model\":\"JoyAI-Code-1.6\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"reply exactly PONG\"}]}'
```

## 快速开始

```bash
git clone <this-repo> && cd joycode-proxy
npm run setup             # 自动从本机 JoyCode IDE 登录态读出 ptKey / tenant 写进 .env
npm start
```

> 没有装 JoyCode IDE？手动也行：
> ```bash
> cp .env.example .env      # 然后填入你自己的 ptKey / tenant
> npm start
> ```

验证：

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/models
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8318/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"JoyAI-Code-1.6","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"reply exactly PONG"}]}'
```

> 零运行时依赖：只用 Node 内置的 `node:http` / `node:crypto`，`npm install` 不是必需的。

## 接 DSH

一条命令即可完成挂载（自动建 junction + 追加 patch 条目，幂等）：

```bash
npm run install:dsh          # 等价于 node install-dsh-plugin.mjs
# 可选：指定 profile / DSH_HOME
DSH_PROFILE=web DSH_HOME=/path/to/.dsh node install-dsh-plugin.mjs
```

手动方式：

1. 把 `dsh-plugin/` 挂进你的 DSH profile（例如用 junction / symlink 放到
   `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-llm-joycode`，或直接 `dsh plugin add` 该目录）。
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: llm-joycode
         name: dsh-llm-joycode
   ```

3. 重启 DSH，模型选择器里应出现 `joycode` provider（5 个模型）。

## 已知限制

- **无状态**：把 OpenAI messages 拍平成单个 prompt，不保留跨请求会话（和 qoder-proxy 一致）。
- **不支持 function calling / tools**：JoyCode 网关的 chat completions 走纯文本路径。
- **单账号串行**：凭据来自一个登录态，多并发请求共享同一账号的积分。
- **签名密钥可能轮换**：密钥是 IDE 内置常量，上游更换后需重新提取，或用 `JOYCODE_SIGN_KEY` 覆盖。

## 免责声明

本项目仅用于在你自己的账号下、于本机把已有的 JoyCode 积分接到其它客户端，
便于个人开发使用。请自行确认你的用法符合服务商条款。作者不对账号封禁、
额度损失或任何间接损害负责。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Cursor-like right sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: file tree, editor, Git, terminal, side chat and Ctrl+L references.
plugins.readme_text:
# CursorLike Sidebar **让 DSH 对话与项目文件在同一工作区协作。** **Browse files, bring code into chat, and review agent edits inside DeepSeek Harness.** `dsh-cursorlike-sidebar` 是嵌入 DSH 原生右侧栏的工作区插件，提供文件浏览、代码编辑、Markdown 预览、Git 差异、原生终端、侧边对话与分屏，主题随 DSH 切换。 A workspace sidebar for DSH with a file browser, code editor, Markdown preview, Git diffs, native terminal, side chat, and split panes. It follows the DSH theme. 独立 DeepSeek Harness 插件，与 Cursor / Anysphere 无隶属关系。 An independent DeepSeek Harness plugin, unaffiliated with Cursor or Anysphere. [功能介绍 · Features](#features) · [安装 · Installation](#installation) · [快捷键 · Shortcuts](#shortcuts) · [更新日志](./CHANGELOG.md) · [Changelog](./CHANGELOG_EN.md) ![在 DSH 中选中 Markdown 文本，通过 Ctrl+L 添加带行号的会话引用 / Add selected Markdown text to chat with Ctrl+L](./docs/screenshots/chat-reference.png) *PPT 演示截图：左侧对话、右侧文件预览，选中文字即可引用。 / Demo from the supplied deck: chat beside a file preview, with selected text ready to reference.* ## 功能介绍 · Features ### 1. 按习惯浏览文件 · Browse your way 同一个工作区支持三种视图，可从文件面板工具栏切换： - **桌面图标网格 / Icon grid**：默认视图，三列排列，首格返回上级。单击文件夹进入、单击文件打开，适合直观浏览。 - **树形列表 / File tree**：展开目录层级，查看项目结构，适合定位源码。 - **Miller 多列 / Miller columns**：逐级目录并排展开，适合在深层路径间浏览。 Switch between a default icon grid, a hierarchical file tree, and Miller columns without leaving the workspace.

*从左到右：图标网格、树形列表、多列视图。 / Left to right: icon grid, file tree, and Miller columns.* 右键可打开文件、新建 Tab、侧边打开、添加引用或复制路径。支持文件多选、复制/剪切/粘贴、重命名、删除及文件操作历史。网格中按住 `Ctrl` 滚轮可调整图标大小（24–160px），64px 以上的图片图标显示缩略图；树形视图支持 10–32px 图标缩放。 Use context menus and multi-selection to manage files, with clipboard operations and file operation history. Ctrl + mouse wheel adjusts icon size, with image thumbnails in larger grid sizes. ### 2. 把文件和选区带入对话 · Bring context into chat 选中文件或代码后按 **`Ctrl+L`**，即可把相关上下文添加到当前对话，减少复制路径、粘贴代码的步骤。 - 文件浏览器：选中文件后添加文件引用。 - 代码编辑器：选中代码后添加行范围；没有选区时添加当前行。 - Markdown 预览：选中文字后映射到源码行号，支持正文中的粗体、列表、行内代码。 - 拖放：将文件引用或选中代码拖入聊天输入区，也可把文件引用拖到文件面板打开。 Press **Ctrl+L** on a selected file, code selection, or Markdown preview text. References use a native `@file` chip with a line suffix such as `line 12-18`. With no editor selection, the current line is referenced. Drag files or selected code into chat for the same workflow. 引用格式示例：`@src/app.ts line 12-18`。Markdown 预览无法唯一定位源码时，会退化为文件引用并附上选中文字，保留必要上下文。 If a Markdown selection cannot be mapped uniquely to source lines, the reference includes the selected text as a fallback. ### 3. 隐藏无关文件 · Keep the file browser focused 在**工作区根目录**创建 `.ignore`，隐藏依赖、构建产物或日志。也可把文件或文件夹拖到工具栏的 **`.ignore` 眼睛图标**，自动追加规则并刷新。 Create a root-level `.ignore` to hide distracting files, or drag a file or folder onto the ignore icon to append a rule and refresh the browser. ```gitignore node_modules .cache *.log ```
查看 PPT 中的 .ignore 示例 · View the .ignore demo
规则使用 gitignore 风格的 glob，当前仅读取根目录 `.ignore`，不支持 `!` 反向选择。手动编辑后点击刷新。隐藏仅影响文件展示，不会删除文件，也不会释放磁盘空间。 Rules use gitignore-style globs. Only the workspace root file is read, and `!` negation is unsupported. Refresh after manual edits. Hiding files affects display only and does not delete them. ### 4. 逐块审查 Agent 修改 · Review agent edits by hunk Agent 修改当前打开的文件后，编辑器直接显示内联差异：新增或改写行标绿，旧内容以红色删除块显示。按改动块（hunk）逐个**保留 / Keep** 或**撤销 / Revert**，处理后自动跳到下一处，操作条显示进度，也可一次处理全部修改。 The editor highlights agent edits inline, with green additions and red deleted content. Keep or revert individual hunks, move automatically to the next change, or handle all changes at once. 「更改」页支持对本轮 write/edit 操作逐行审查：每个改动行右侧有 ✓ 保留 / ✕ 撤销，当前行高亮；处理完一行自动跳到下一行，一个文件全部处理完后自动切到下一个改动文件。只有能重建完整旧内容、且磁盘仍匹配该操作结果时才启用写回；否则显示只读 diff 与原因。**撤销会立即写回磁盘。** The Changes tab reviews write/edit operations line by line: every changed line carries ✓ Keep / ✕ Revert, the active line is highlighted, and resolving a line jumps to the next one; finishing a file selects the next changed file. Review actions require a complete previous version and a matching current file. Otherwise, the diff stays read-only with an explanation. **Revert writes to disk immediately.** 未处理的编辑器审查状态按会话与文件保存在本地。重启后，文件仍匹配待审版本时恢复；处理完毕后清除。 Pending editor reviews are saved locally per session and file, and restored after restart when the file still matches the pending version. ### 5. 编辑、终端与分屏 · Edit, run, and compare 代码编辑、Markdown 预览、搜索、Git 差异、原生终端与侧边对话都可在 DSH 中使用。分屏便于并排查看文件和操作结果，减少在外部窗口间切换。 Use editing, previews, search, Git diffs, a native terminal, and side chat inside DSH. Split panes help keep files and results visible together. 安装 `dsh-diff-approval` 时，本插件还提供原生右侧栏 dock 集成与 Keep/Revert 快捷键转发。首次将其旧浮层迁到 dock 后，会保留用户显式改回 float 的选择。 Optional `dsh-diff-approval` integration docks its review panel in the native sidebar and forwards Keep/Revert shortcuts, while respecting a later explicit switch back to floating mode. ## 常用快捷键 · Shortcuts 快捷键随焦点生效：文件操作、文本编辑和 Diff 审查各自使用对应上下文。 Shortcuts act on the focused browser, editor, or review surface. - **`Ctrl+L`**：文件、选区或当前行添加到会话 / Add file, selection, or current line to chat. - **`Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+X` / `Ctrl+V`**：文件浏览器中复制、剪切、粘贴 / Copy, cut, and paste files in the browser. - **`Ctrl+Z`**：撤销当前上下文中的操作；审查时撤销上一步决定 / Undo in the active context, including the last review decision. - **`Ctrl+Shift+Z` / `Ctrl+Y`**：文件浏览器中重做 / Redo file browser operations. - **`F5`**：刷新文件浏览器 / Refresh the file browser. - **`Ctrl+K` / `Ctrl+J`**：保留 / 撤销当前改动块（编辑器）或当前改动行（更改页）/ Keep or revert the active hunk (editor) or line (Changes tab). - **`Ctrl+Alt+K` / `Ctrl+Alt+J`**：全部保留 / 全部撤销 / Keep or revert all changes. - **`Ctrl+滚轮 / mouse wheel`**：调整文件图标大小 / Resize file icons. 保留 DSH 原有 `Ctrl+B` 行为，无需额外桌面软件或 Python 运行时，不包含 PDF 依赖。 The plugin preserves DSH's existing Ctrl+B behavior and requires no additional desktop app or Python runtime. It does not bundle PDF dependencies. ## 安装 · Installation 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及兼容版本。安装前停用原版 `dsh-better-sidebar`，安装或更新后完全退出并重启 DSH。 Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 or a compatible version. Disable the original `dsh-better-sidebar` before installing, then fully restart DSH after installation or updates. ### npm（发布后可用 · After publication） 插件发布到 npm 后可安装包名： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-cursorlike-sidebar ``` 只有 npm / GitHub 来源能被 DSH Plugin Market 检查更新；本地 `link:` 安装和固定 tag 的 tarball 不会自动更新。 ### Release（不需要 Git · No Git required） 以下为固定的历史版本 `0.28.0-cursorlike.1`，不代表当前工作区版本。其他版本请在 [Releases](https://github.com/Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar/releases) 选择对应资源。 The command below installs the pinned historical release, not the current workspace version. ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar/releases/download/v0.28.0-cursorlike.1/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar-0.28.0-cursorlike.1.tgz ``` ### GitHub（需要 Git · Requires Git） 需要本机 `git` 在 PATH 上（pnpm 解析 `github:` 规格会调用 git）： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Oxygen-Wang/dsh-cursorlike-sidebar ``` 也可以在 DSH 的「添加插件」里填入上面的 GitHub 规格，安装后重启 DSH。 仓库已提交构建好的 `lib/`（不含 source map），因此 GitHub 安装不需要本地构建。 ### 本地开发 · Local development 插件已经以 `link:` 方式安装时，不需要每次重装。依赖只需装一次： ```powershell npm install ``` 启动监听（`tsdown --watch`，不需要 pnpm 在 PATH 上）： ```powershell npm run dev # 或： pwsh -File scripts/dev.ps1 ``` - 改客户端代码：保存后按 `Ctrl+R` 刷新 DSH 页面； - 改 Host 代码（`src/index.ts`、`src/*.ts`）：需要完全重启 DSH； - 一次性构建：`npm run build` - 类型检查：`npm run typecheck` 在 DSH「添加插件」里选择本地目录 `dsh-cursorlike`。 先停用原版 `dsh-better-sidebar`：本分支保留其内部服务和路由，二者不能同时启用。 安装或更新后需要重启 DSH，插件才会在原生右侧栏中挂载。 通过 DSH 原生右侧栏入口使用。 ## 更新方式 · Updates DSH 的 **Plugin Market** 会为已安装插件做更新检查： - **npm 安装**：比较已安装版本与 npm `latest`，有一键 Update / Update all； - **GitHub 安装**：比较 git HEAD 与版本；只有版本前进（发版/改版本号）才提供更新，普通 commit 只显示“有新提交（未发版）”； - **本地 `

plugins.description: Codex-style glowing reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer · DSH 推理强度滑块（Codex 风格）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-reasoning-glow

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-reasoning-glow.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-reasoning-glow)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-reasoning-glow.svg)](LICENSE)

把 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）输入框里的模型选择器，换成一条 **Codex 风格**的发光推理强度滑块。

A **Codex-style**, glowing reasoning-effort slider for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) composer: drag the pill, the effort changes, and the top level lights up with drifting motes.

![dsh-codexstyle-slide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WH-kt/dsh-codexstyle-slide/main/docs/screenshot.webp)

## Codex 风格 / Codex-style

这个面板参考了 Codex 系推理强度选择器的视觉语言：

- **档位名是主角**：居中的粗体档位名（如 `高` / `Max`），最高档用渐变字呈现
- **模型名是配角**：紧挨其下的小号灰字 + `›`，点开才是模型列表
- **一条粗胶囊轨道**：大号圆形白色拖钮，刻度点沿轨道排布，拖动即时预览
- **最高档才有的流光**：蓝紫渐变铺满轨道，细碎粒子缓慢上浮、明暗呼吸

和 DSH 的既有交互做了保留：拖动松手才写入会话、模型列表仍可从模型名进入、`↺` 一键回到服务商默认档位。

## 特性 / Features

- **胶囊轨道 + 圆形拖钮**：拖动、点击轨道、`←` `→` `↑` `↓` `Home` `End` 都能切换档位，松手才真正提交
- **最高档特效**：轨道切换为蓝紫渐变，18 颗白色粒子各自上浮、摆动、明暗呼吸
- **档位标题实时跟随**：拖动过程中标题立即切换到对应档位名
- **↺ 恢复默认**：一键回到该模型服务商提供的默认档位
- **模型列表仍在**：点模型名展开分组模型列表，换模型后自动带回当前档位
- 深浅色主题自动适配；中英文界面；`prefers-reduced-motion` 时粒子静止
- 单文件浏览器端代码，无构建步骤，无第三方依赖

## 安装 / Install

### 通过 npm

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-reasoning-glow
# 若你的 CLI 要求显式 profile：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-reasoning-glow
```

也可以在 DSH 的插件管理器里按包名搜索安装。

### 从源码

```sh
git clone https://github.com/WH-kt/dsh-codexstyle-slide.git
dsh plugin add ./dsh-codexstyle-slide
```

或者：DSH 桌面端 → 设置 → 插件 → 用插件管理器安装这个本地目录。

安装后插件作为 profile 层生效，**刷新页面**即可看到新的滑块。

## 兼容性 / Compatibility

- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（Web 与桌面端），Node.js `>=22`
- 通过 `conversation.input.model` 槽位（`priority: -1`）接管模型选择器
- 依赖 Client 服务：`slots`、`modelDirectories`、`sessions`、`locale`、`remote`、`remote.session`
- 模型目录通过槽位的 `inject(sessionId)` 获取，不做任何模型或认证上的假设

## 开发 / Development

```sh
npm test        # test/smoke.mjs：32 项运行时契约 + 渲染检查，不需要浏览器
```

```
.
├── client.js            # 浏览器端：UI、样式、槽位注册（无构建）
├── index.js             # Host 端空实现，让加载器看到这个插件
├── cordis.patch.yml     # bundle 层：把插件插入 profile
├── locale/{zh,en}.json  # 插件管理器中显示的标题/描述
├── icon.svg             # 插件图标
└── test/smoke.mjs       # 无浏览器冒烟测试
```

`test/smoke.mjs` 会用假的 `window.__ModuleLoader__`、React 和 Cordis 上下文加载真实
`client.js`，验证注入清单、槽位注册契约、`load/select` 通路、滑块提交、模型列表渲染
以及最高档的渐变/粒子分支。

## 许可 / License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: LaTeX compile gate + VTO typesetting loop for DeepSeek Harness: MiKTeX-native, 10 tools, 3 skills, persistent defect ledger, and a Plugins-page configuration form
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-latex-studio

> MiKTeX 原生的 **LaTeX 编译 + VTO（Visual Typesetting Optimization，视觉排版优化）闭环**插件，面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）桌面端。
> 两套命令体系：**A 线 日常编译**（`latex_doctor` / `latex_build` / `latex_lint` / `bib_tool`）与 **B 线 VTO 全流程**（`vto_start` / `vto_inspect` / `vto_fix` / `vto_verify` / `vto_report`）。
> 方法学参考 PaperFit（MIT，[arXiv:2605.10341](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10341)），要点见 [docs/paperfit-notes.md](docs/paperfit-notes.md)；模块契约见 [docs/INTERFACES.md](docs/INTERFACES.md)；验收见 [docs/ACCEPTANCE.md](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)。
>
> 🔧 **维护 / 开发从这里开始：[docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)** —— 架构、工具面、配置契约、维护配方、排错、已知问题，以及历史记录。
> 🧭 **设计依据与取舍**：见 DEVELOPMENT.md §7（关键设计决策与**被否决的方案**）。
>
> ℹ️ **技能由插件自己注册**，装完插件即可用，不需要额外步骤（见 §2.5）。`skills/` 里只有本插件自己的 3 个 `latex-*`；vendor 自 PaperFit 的上游规范自 0.2.0 起只作参考文本（`docs/upstream/paperfit/`），不再注册、不随包发布。

## 1. 它解决什么问题

「编译通过」不等于「可投稿」：孤行寡行、浮动体远离引用、双栏列内空洞、Overfull、表格字号不一等**二维版面缺陷**，只看源码和 `.log` 是看不出来的。
本插件把「**编译 → 读日志 → 渲染页图 → 诊断（18 类缺陷）→ 受限修复 → 门禁复核**」做成可复现的 DSH 工具链：

- **不依赖 latexmk**：MiKTeX 的 latexmk 是 Perl 脚本、需要 Perl（本机没有）。`latex_build` 自研多趟驱动（引擎 → 需要时 bibtex/biber → 直到 `.aux` 稳定，最多 4 趟）。
- **页图后端全部本地、零额外安装**：MiKTeX 自带 Poppler（`pdftoppm`）与 Ghostscript（`mgs.exe`）；MinerU 只作可选兜底。
- **外部件缺失绝不抛异常**：一律降级为 `status:'skipped'` + `advice`（可执行的修复命令）。
- **写操作原子化**：先备份 → 再写 → 用内容守卫校验 → 失败回滚；`vto_fix` 默认 `apply:false` 只给配方与 diff。
- **缺陷台账跨轮持久**：`vto_report({defects:[…]})` 按 `id+page` 落进 `state.json`，`vto_verify` 对「标了 fixed 又复发」判回归、对未清的阻断级缺陷降级 verdict——这是 PaperFit 相对朴素多轮视觉的全部增益来源（显式缺陷记录 + 受限修复 + 门禁）。
- **编译驱动**：默认优先 `latexmk`（带 `.fls` 依赖追踪；需要 Perl，Git 自带亦可），不可用时自动回落内置多趟驱动，两者产出同一结果结构（`via` 标明走了哪条）。
- **隐私内置**：`uploadScope` 闸门统一决定「哪种 PDF 解析可以上传」，默认不外发本人稿件。

## 2. 安装与自检

### 2.1 一条命令（推荐）

```powershell
cd <本仓库>\dsh-latex-studio
node tools/install.mjs              # 打包 → 注册进 profile → 镜像到 node_modules → 自检
```

它会：① `npm pack`（遵守 `files` 白名单，`tools/_p0` 调研证据永远不会进发布集）；
② 备份 profile 清单并登记 bundle；③ 把包树镜像进 `node_modules`（保留已有 `node_modules`）；
④ 用 `tools/doctor.mjs` 验证部署副本，**失败即报错并给出回滚命令**。

参数：`--profile <名字>`（默认 `desktop`）、`--dry-run`（只打印计划，不改任何东西）、
`--no-pack`（复用已打好的 tgz）。

> 安装完会提示 `restart DSH`。**必须重启或开新会话**，新构建才会被加载——正在运行的进程用的仍是旧实例。

### 2.2 自检：`node tools/doctor.mjs`

**装完就该跑一次。** 这个插件最危险的失败模式是"装上了但没加载"，而**没加载的插件无法注册工具
来告诉你它没加载**——所以诊断必须能在插件之外运行：

```powershell
node tools/doctor.mjs                  # 检查当前目录
node tools/doctor.mjs --dir <安装副本>  # 检查别的副本
node tools/doctor.mjs --json           # 机器可读（CI 用）
```

它按顺序回答 5 个问题：**文件齐不齐 → `apply()` 能否注册 10 个工具 + 技能包 → bundle 有没有登记进
profile → 发现根里有没有重复技能（会互相遮蔽）→ 本机 LaTeX 工具链能不能真编译/渲染**。
0.4.0 起还会检查**浏览器半**（`lib/client.js` 的加载器格式与槽位注册）、`locale/` 展示元信息，
并在 `volatile` 行报告本副本解析到的 Schemastery 支持情况（0.4.1 起即使宿主那棵树是旧版，插件也会换用自带的副本，配置页仍可编辑；见 DEVELOPMENT §4.5）。

退出码：`0` 健康｜`1` 有失败项｜`2` 脚本自身出错。本机实测输出：

```
[OK  ] files      28 required files present
[OK  ] patch      inserts the plugin row with no duplicated defaults
[OK  ] tools      10 tools registered: latex_doctor, latex_build, latex_lint, bib_tool,
                  vto_start, vto_inspect, vto_fix, vto_verify, vto_report, vto_rollback
[OK  ] skills     3 skills registered: latex-daily, latex-fix-catalog, latex-vto-loop
[OK  ] volatile   17 config fields are volatile → editable in the Plugins page
[OK  ] client     declares dsh.client (web) and exports ./client
[OK  ] clientBundle lazy-CJS factory, requires react only, registers both config slots
[OK  ] locale     en/zh display metadata present
[OK  ] profile    registered in: desktop
[OK  ] in-sync    this directory IS what profile "desktop" loads
[OK  ] shadows    no discovery root duplicates the plugin-registered skills
[OK  ] toolchain  engine=D:\MiKTeX\miktex\bin\x64\pdflatex.exe (MiKTeX-pdfTeX 4.27 (MiKTeX 26.5))
[OK  ] render     page-image backend: poppler (pdftoppm+pdfinfo)
[OK  ] bib        bibliography tooling: bibtex, biber
verdict: HEALTHY
```

> 如果宿主解析到的是**旧版** schemastery，这一行会变成 `volatile` 的说明 + 一条 `logger` WARN（提示正在使用插件自带的副本），verdict 仍是 HEALTHY——配置页照常可编辑。

### 2.3 手工安装（不用脚本时）

正规通道是**应用内插件管理器**。走命令行时用**桌面端自带的 CLI**：

```powershell
npm pack
& "D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add (Resolve-Path .\dsh-latex-studio-*.tgz)
& "D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin list --profile desktop
```

> ⚠️ 请用上面的**全路径** `dsh.cmd`（默认安装在 `D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\`）：
> PATH 上可能还有更早的全局 `dsh`（本机是 **0.1.5-rc.1**），桌面端自带的是 **0.2.1-rc.2**；
> 用错版本操作不到桌面端 profile（见 §9）。
> ⚠️ 本机实测 `dsh plugin add` 在 Electron 独占管理的 profile 上**会挂起**，所以日常请用 §2.1 的脚本。
> 也**不要**用 `--profile desktop --dump-config` 校验（同样被拒绝）。

**从 GitHub 安装（无需构建）**：本仓库直接提交可运行的 `lib/`（纯 JS，没有构建步骤、没有 `prepare` 脚本），
所以 `github:` 安装不需要授权任何构建脚本：

```powershell
& "D:\DshDesktop\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:Qingzhu093/dsh-latex-studio
# 建议锁定 commit，避免后续推送悄悄改变实际运行的代码：
& "...\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add github:Qingzhu093/dsh-latex-studio#<sha>
```

### 2.4 升级 / 卸载

```powershell
node tools/install.mjs        # 升级 = 再跑一次（每次自动备份 profile 清单）
node tools/doctor.mjs         # 升级后自检
```

卸载：从 profile 的 `package.json` 删掉 `dependencies` 里的依赖与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的条目，
再删掉安装副本目录。（清单在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<名字>/package.json`，`$DSH_HOME` 默认 `~/.dsh`。）

**发布前自证**：`npm run verify:package`（`tools/verify-package.mjs`）会真的 `npm pack` 一份 tarball，
然后逐条断言：白名单没漏进 `docs/`/`tools/_p0/`/`node_modules`、必需文件齐全、`exports` 的每个目标都在包里、
从**解包后的副本**里 `import` 宿主半并跑通 `apply()`（10 工具 + 3 技能）、浏览器半是客户端模块系统要的
lazy-CJS 工厂且只 `require("react")`、零运行时依赖、图标与 locale 元信息合法，最后打印字节数与 sha256。
`doctor` 查"这个目录对不对"，`verify:package` 查"这个包装出去会不会坏"——两者互补。

### 2.5 技能：由插件自己注册（不需要额外步骤）

**装了插件就有技能。** `lib/index.js` 在 `apply()` 里调用 `ctx.skills.register()` 把整包技能
注册出去（**只有本插件自己的 3 个 `latex-*`**：`latex-daily`、`latex-vto-loop`、`latex-fix-catalog`）。
注册是 effect，插件卸载时自动撤销；不需要安装脚本、不需要文件链接、不需要改 profile 配置。

> 0.2.0 起**不再注册 vendored 的上游规范**：那些文本描述的是 PaperFit 的 agent/命令/路径（`data/pages/`、220 DPI、`/check-visual`），注册进来等于让模型拿别人的操作规程当本插件的手册。上游原文保留在 `docs/upstream/paperfit/`（含 MANIFEST 与逐文件哈希）作**只读参考**，`docs/` 也已移出发布白名单。

```js
// lib/index.js（节选）
const service = ctx.get('skills')            // 可选依赖，故意不放进 inject
if (service?.register) registerSkillPack(service, loadSkillPack().skills)
```

> **为什么不能只把文件放进 `skills/`。** DSH 的技能发现只扫描**配置好的根目录**
> （官方 Skills 参考的"本地发现优先级"）：
>
> | rank | source | 根目录 |
> |---|---|---|
> | 100 | `project-dsh` | `<项目根>/.dsh/skills` |
> | 200 | `project-agents` | `<项目根>/.agents/skills` |
> | 300 | `custom` | `Config.customSkillDirs` |
> | 400 | `user-dsh` | `<dshHome>/skills` |
> | 500 | `user-agents` | `<agentsHome>/skills` |
> | 600 | `bundled` | `Config.bundledSkillDir` |
>
> **npm 包自己的 `skills/` 不在其中。** 本项目此前就是这样：3 个 `latex-*` 技能随包发布很久，
> 却一次都没被任何会话发现过。DSH 是围绕插件设计的，插件既然已经装载，就没有理由再绕一圈做文件发现。
>
> `skills` 是**可选**依赖（`ctx.get` 而不是 `inject`）：组合里没有技能服务时，10 个工具照常可用，
> 而不是让插件永远 PENDING——PENDING 的插件连一个工具都注册不了。

**不用插件时怎么读技能**：直接打开 `skills/<名字>/SKILL.md` 即可（例如在编辑器或 CI 里）。
0.2.0 删除了 `tools/install-skills.mjs`：它是为「技能不进上下文」那个已经修好的问题写的兜底，而把同一批技能同时注册又放进发现根，只会互相遮蔽。


### 2.6 环境要求与自助安装（发布版必读）

**硬依赖只有一个：MiKTeX。** 它同时提供引擎、`bibtex`/`biber`/`makeindex`、页图后端（Poppler `pdftoppm`/`pdfinfo`、Ghostscript `mgs.exe`）。其余全部可选，缺了就降级，绝不抛异常。

模型先跑 `latex_doctor`：它逐项报出「已装 / 缺失 + 安装命令」，`advice[]` 里就是可执行命令。对照表：

| Perl + `latexmk` | 可选（推荐） | `.fls` 依赖追踪、正确重跑 | 自动回落内置多趟驱动（结果结构一致，只是没有依赖追踪） | `winget install StrawberryPerl.StrawberryPerl`；或使用 Git 自带的 `<Git>\usr\bin\perl.exe`（探测会自动找到） |
